Lena Ortiz: quick: drafting customer note for the onboarding slowdown earlier today. want a concise status + next steps + feedback capture. draft below, please flag edits.

Caleb Wong: please include an explicit SLO impact line (e.g., "Some onboarding jobs were delayed, not dropped"). customers ask about data loss often.

Noor Ahmed: agree with Caleb. also suggest we offer a short remediation window: "We can prioritize your job if you reply with your tenant id". helps triage high-value accounts.

Lena Ortiz: good call. added. initial outbound below. trying to keep tone empathetic and actionable.

-- OUTBOUND DRAFT --
Hi {{customer_name}},

Were writing with an update about the onboarding delays you may have seen today. Wee applied a fix that stopped the errors and were processing the backlog. Most jobs are completing; normal throughput should return within 24	60 hours depending on queue depth. No customer data was dropped.

What we changed:
A temporary caching policy that caused head-of-line blocking was reverted at 09:12 PT.
Were routing affected jobs to a prioritized worker pool.
Were continuously monitoring progress and will update https://status.redwood-inference.com.

If this impacts a scheduled go-live or renewal, reply to this message with your tenant id and were escalate for immediate remediation.

Feedback: were running a 20-minute listening and feedback session Wednesday 11am PT and will email a short survey after the session. RSVP: https://forms.redwood-inference.com/onboard-feedback (checkbox to request 1:1).

Credits: for affected onboarding runs were issuing a 5% service credit applied to the next invoice. For accounts >$50k ARR CS will coordinate manual approval.

Thanks for bearing with us,
Lena and the Redwood CS team
-- END DRAFT --

Samir Patel: language looks good. two asks: (1) reduce credit to 5% (legal asked) 	6 done above, (2) add a short technical note link for advanced users.

Legal Bot: approved for 5% credit. flag: any accounts >$50k ARR must be reviewed by legal before public outbound.

Noor Ahmed: also add a micro-runbook link for customers who want troubleshooting steps: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/onboard-mitigation (short link ok).

Caleb Wong: infra summary for outbound (short): "Root cause: interaction between onboarding queuer and a new cache policy leading to head-of-line blocking. Mitigation reverted the policy; backlog processed with burst workers at ~1.7x baseline." use if customers ask for more detail.

SRE Bot: incident logged: INC-4412, sev=2, start=2024-10-22T07:08:00Z, mitigated=2024-10-22T09:12:00Z, internal RCA: https://intra.redwood/rcas/4412

Lena Ortiz: ok next steps:
Noor to finalize outbound copy with doc links (ASAP).
Samir to prepare the RSVP + survey (include 1:1 checkbox).
Caleb to post the short infra blurb and final ETA.
Legal to produce list of >$50k accounts for prior approval.

Please ack if youre on it. want to send by EOD to minimize customer surprise.

Caleb Wong: ack 	6 will post ETA by 10:30am PT.

Noor Ahmed: ack 	6 updating now, will paste final copy here.

Samir Patel: ack 	6 will share RSVP link in 15m. happy to moderate session.

Legal Bot: ack 	6 will DM the >$50k list.

Lena Ortiz: thanks all. will hold send until legal confirms list. will follow up when outbound is posted. :email:
